info.longName: iShares ESG Optimized MSCI USA ETF

funds_data.description: The fund seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI USA Extended ESG Select Index, which is an optimized index designed to maximize exposure to positive environmental, social and governance (“ESG”) characteristics, while exhibiting risk and return characteristics similar to the MSCI USA Index. The index is designed to measure the performance of the large- and mid-capitalization segments of the U.S. equities market.
